question: According to the Indian Constitution, no child below the age of ______ years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment.
solution:
The correct answer is __**fourteen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Child Labour** is the practice of having children** engaged in economic activity, on a part or full-time basis which can be harmful to their physical, mental, and social development.**
 
• Under Article 24 of the fundamental rights of the constitution of India, child labour is prohibited.
